name: sesh
title: Sesh - Focus Timer
description: Run your sesh focus timer from Raycast: start and finish sessions, check what is running, pick a Things or Todoist to-do to work on, and set a custom intention.
author: ivan_lee

preferences.name: authUsername
preferences.title: App Username
preferences.description: Shared app-login username for protected sesh-web deployments

preferences.name: authPassword
preferences.title: App Password
preferences.description: Shared app-login password for protected sesh-web deployments

preferences.name: defaultDuration
preferences.title: Default Focus Duration (minutes)
preferences.description: Fallback focus length, used only when the sesh server's own setting cannot be read. sesh's Focus Duration setting normally wins.

commands.name: menu-bar-timer
commands.title: Timer Status
commands.subtitle: sesh
commands.description: Show timer countdown in the menu bar

commands.name: view-timer
commands.title: Check Session
commands.subtitle: sesh
commands.description: See what is running: progress, overtime, category and linked to-dos

commands.name: start-focus
commands.title: Start Focus Session
commands.subtitle: sesh
commands.description: Start a session with an intention, a category and linked to-dos

commands.name: quick-start
commands.title: Quick Start Focus
commands.subtitle: sesh
commands.description: Start focusing on whatever sesh already has queued up, at your configured length

commands.name: tasks
commands.title: Tasks
commands.subtitle: sesh
commands.description: Browse your Things and Todoist to-dos, start a session on one, or add a new one

commands.name: set-intention
commands.title: Set Intention
commands.subtitle: sesh
commands.description: Write a custom intention for the running session, or queue one up for the next

commands.name: pause-resume
commands.title: Pause/Resume Timer
commands.subtitle: sesh
commands.description: Toggle pause on the running timer

commands.name: finish-session
commands.title: Finish Session
commands.subtitle: sesh
commands.description: End the running session and record it

commands.name: view-analytics
commands.title: View Analytics
commands.subtitle: sesh
commands.description: See today's focus stats and streak
